captions.text: When we do research studies, people change their diets, they do great,
but the one food that keeps kind of in the back of their mind is cheese.
People say, "You know, I think I'm kind of addicted to cheese."
And the answer is, yes, you may well be.
We found that there are certain compounds in cheese that truly are addictive.
We explain what they are, how you can break that cheese addiction,
And a lot of replacements for cheese, with all the flavor, none of the regrets.
